carousel.description: 6-slide educational carousel — highest save and share rate
carousel.notes: slide 1 is the hook — most important. slide 6 is always soft CTA.

caption.description: single-image pain-point caption — drives profile visits and follows
caption.hook_purpose: open with a line that stops a speaker mid-scroll
caption.notes: end with — Reeve attribution. short paragraphs, 1-2 sentences max.

reevefound.description: 'Reeve found this' — demonstrates the agency doing its job, finding real opportunities
reevefound.hook_purpose: show proof of work — real conferences, real deadlines
reevefound.notes: ends with 'That's the job. — Reeve'. never names specific clients.

reel.description: 20-second reel script — highest reach, drives new followers
reel.hook_purpose: pattern interrupt — speaker hears this and thinks 'that's me'
reel.notes: hook 2 sec, body 12 sec, cta 6 sec. include b-roll notes inline.
reel.image_type: reel_hook — just the hook line as a quote-style image
